scope: Three repetitions of one deterministic native fixture using the same WAV and controlled input pacing. Mechanism evidence only; not an end-to-end playback, real-time reliability, or Fruit/Reserve A/B qualification.
interpretation: In this controlled fixture, immediate input completes without synthetic zero samples. A deliberate 2-second input gate creates a measurable wait with produced and consumed sample accounting aligned, then recovers when input resumes. This validates the fixture mechanism and its assertions only; it does not show that an actual playback interruption is fixed.
runtime: No new executable was built for this result. The normal GUI remains on the prior a1b8013b10e1 build.
